body:
7 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Families allege stray firework went into crowd at Heywood Christmas lights switch-on (Heywood). Parents at Heywood's Christmas lights switch-on allege a stray firework went into the crowd this evening, coming within a metre or two of a three-year-old.

Animal charity serving Rochdale seeks stallholders for Christmas fairs (Rochdale). PAWS is inviting stallholders to apply for December events in Uppermill and Todmorden, supporting a rescue charity whose work includes Rochdale.

Buckley Hall Prison: drugs, self-harm and ‘requires improvement’ (Rochdale). Rochdale’s category C prison is meant to send men home sober, skilled and steadier. Inspectors and monitors say drugs, lock-ups and thin education are getting in the way.

Hopwood Hall: DePree's appeal deadline nears after High Court defeat (Middleton). Hopwood DePree has until Wednesday 18 November to seek permission to appeal. Who he is, how he came to Middleton's Hopwood Hall, why the council ended his deal, and what happens next.

The Healey Dell prophecy: Eleanor Byron, Mother Bagden and what the records actually show (Healey). A centuries‑old tale that a Lady Eleanor would be “maid, wife and widow in one day” survives in Healey Dell’s visitor guides — but it begins with nineteenth‑century collectors, not medieval paperwork.

Laced vapes: what is in them, how they reach children, and how to report sellers (Rochdale). Vapes sold to children as cannabis oil are being found to contain spice, a far stronger synthetic drug that has put young people in hospital.

Middleton Shopping Centre puts on Rochdale's best fireworks display (Middleton). A huge display shot from the roof of Middleton Shopping Centre provided an unforgettable finale to the town's Christmas lights switch-on.

Weather: Light rain 6°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
